pages.title: Creative flight
pages.text: The Flux Ship is an experimental vehicle without a survival crafting recipe. If you have one, place it in a clear area with room for its hull and right-click to board.$(br2)W/S move forward and backward; A/D turn. Up/Down or Space/Backspace control height. Release the controls to brake and hover. Sneak dismounts.

pages.title: Handling a ship
pages.text: The transparent cockpit hologram shows speed in km/h, altitude as world Y, and your current controls while leaving the view ahead visible.$(br2)Acceleration and turning build gradually. The ship banks in moving turns and pitches when climbing or descending. Release controls to brake into a level hover.$(br2)Flight follows the ship’s heading. Looking around does not steer.

pages.title: Cockpit view
pages.text: First-person camera tilt follows the hull. Reduce or disable it using utility.fluxShipCameraTilt (0 to 1) in ariente-client.toml.$(br2)The third-person camera stays upright and can look around. Your pilot model stays seated facing forward and tilts with the hull.$(br2)Sneak-hit an unattended ship to recover its item. Ships reload parked. Find a clear landing area before dismounting; there is no automatic landing or navigation.
